content: Nitazoxanide is a synthetic antiprotozoal agent designed for oral administration. It is presented as a light yellow crystalline powder that exhibits poor solubility in ethanol and is practically insoluble in water. Chemically, nitazoxanide is identified as 2-acetyloxy-N-(5-nitro-2-thiazolyl)benzamide. Alinia Tablets contain 500 mg of nitazoxanide as the active ingredient. The tablets also include the following inactive ingredients: maize starch, pregelatinized corn starch, hydroxypropyl methylcellulose, sucrose, sodium starch glycolate, talc, magnesium stearate, soy lecithin, polyvinyl alcohol, xanthan gum, titanium dioxide, FD&C Yellow No. 10 Aluminum Lake, FD&C Yellow No. 6 Aluminum Lake, and FD&C Blue No. 2 Aluminum Lake. Alinia for Oral Suspension, when reconstituted with 48 mL of water, yields 60 mL of a homogeneous pink suspension. This suspension contains 100 mg of nitazoxanide per 5 mL. The inactive ingredients in the suspension include sodium benzoate, sucrose, xanthan gum, microcrystalline cellulose and carboxymethylcellulose sodium, anhydrous citric acid, sodium citrate dihydrate, maltodextrin, modified food starch, triacetin, FD&C Red No. 40, and artificial strawberry flavoring.
